title: MCP VCR Transcript Schema v1
description: JSON Schema for validating version 1 MCP VCR transcript YAML files.

version.description: The transcript format version. Must be 1.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the session was recorded.

server_command.description: The command and arguments used to launch the target MCP server subprocess.

protocol_version.description: The negotiated Model Context Protocol version (e.g. '2024-11-05'). Captured lazily.

client_hint.description: Name of the client that connected to the server. Captured lazily.

t.description: Monotonic relative timestamp in milliseconds since session start.

dir.description: Direction of transmission: client-to-server (c2s) or server-to-client (s2c).
